title: Branch names cut at 40 characters mid-word and can collide
what: Find whether the 40-character limit has a reason (a path or socket length limit); if not, use the full slug; if so, cut at a word boundary and make the name unique (refuse or add a short suffix when a branch of that name exists or a second item maps to it). Match metrics units by the item's recorded branch, not by a prefix.
why: The owner saw "taken_by": "wt/the-test-runner-leaves-test-tokens-outsi" and asked why it is cut. lib/relay_lanes.py:401 `_short` cuts the slug at 40 characters with no reason in code or history; 259 of 303 queue slugs are longer than 40. Measured 30 Oct: 4 pairs of items share the same 40-character name (read-only-guard-lets-a-critic-run-relay, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-whe, test-scaffolding-for-per-command-modules, type-check-subfolders-and-cap-module-siz), so two such items would get one branch, and relay_metrics.py:126 matches units by the first 40 characters too.
failing_case: 30 Oct: `relay queue start` gave branch wt/the-test-runner-leaves-test-tokens-outsi for item the-test-runner-leaves-test-tokens-outside-its-t; 4 pairs of existing slugs map to one 40-character name.
pass_cases: Two items whose slugs share the first 40 characters get two different branches.
A branch name never ends inside a word, or is the full slug.
relay metrics shows one unit per item for those two items.
